name: Korea International Circuit
summary: Korea's Grand Prix track, built on reclaimed land near the port of Mokpo.
character: A long back straight, then a tight final sector meant to be lined by a city that was never built.

moments.title: Racing into the dark
moments.body: The first race in 2010 started late behind the safety car because of heavy rain and finished in fading light. Fernando Alonso won.

leftCalendar: Small crowds and heavy losses. The Korean Grand Prix was dropped after 2013.
